name: Scramble (the best combination)
engine: The decoy, the late runner and loose balls together: the best combination the simulations found.
about: The pieces from Bait and switch and Broken play that changed the most decisions, in one team. Oyarzabal is the decoy (a centre-back follows him until he touches the ball) and the pass meant for him goes to Fabián arriving late (+2 to the pass). Their defence is set for the last kind of move each of your men tried (+2 to them if he tries it again, +2 to him for anything else), so you keep changing the move. A hard shot their keeper only saves is loose in their box, and it falls to Olmo. On defence, a lost tackle becomes a foul that costs a booking.
